== Summary ==
Two cards from [[John Anderson]]'s collection carrying the gold foil "P71 John Anderson" memorial stamp: •Maul's Sith Infiltrator and •We're In Attack Position Now. Cards from John's collection, heat-foil stamped in his memory, were given out in the memorial booster packs at the [[2019 North American Continental Championship]] (the John Anderson Memorial Tournament), Bloomington, Minnesota, 23–25 August 2019. The "P" is the Players Committee promo logo; the "71" refers to John's call sign, Puck 71.

* '''Date:''' posted 27 August 2019
* '''Image:''' native image file as posted (2576 × 1932)
